step1_analysis.circuit_type: Current-Steering DAC Cell with Switch Driver
step1_analysis.description: A differential current-steering DAC cell featuring a reduced-swing PMOS switch driver and NMOS current steering switches. The driver converts digital inputs into limited-swing signals to drive the NMOS switches, minimizing clock feedthrough and keeping the tail current source in saturation.

paper_reference.title: A CMOS Oversampling Bandpass Cascaded D/A Converter With Digital FIR and Current-Mode Semi-Digital Filtering

gain.description: Small-signal AC gain of the switch driver (proxy for the 83 dB dynamic range reported in the paper).

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm_xm4 * (Rout_up || Rout_down). With gm ~ 1mA/V and Rout ~ 100kOhm, Gain ~ 100 V/V = 40 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The driver acts as a high-impedance loaded amplifier in small-signal. Actual gain depends strongly on the bias point.

frequency.description: Unity gain frequency of the driver (relates to the 50 MHz center frequency and 200 MHz sampling rate).

sky130_expected.calculation: UGF = gm / (2 * pi * C_load). With gm ~ 1mA/V and C_load ~ 20fF, UGF ~ 8 GHz. However, internal poles will limit this to ~1-2 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The cell must switch fast enough to support the 200 MHz sampling rate, requiring a bandwidth well above 200 MHz.

power.description: DC power consumption of the single DAC cell (paper reports 215 mW for the entire converter).

sky130_expected.calculation: I_tail ~ 44 uA. I_pmos ~ 2 * 36 uA. Total I ~ 116 uA. Power = 1.8V * 116 uA = 208 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on the applied bias voltages (0.6V for tail, 1.0V for PMOS) and SKY130 parameters.

v_max.description: Maximum high-level voltage of the driver output N1 during switching.

sky130_expected.calculation: When XM4 is OFF, XM12 pulls N1 up until it enters deep triode, reaching VDD (1.8V).
sky130_expected.reasoning: The PMOS current source will pull the node to VDD if there is no DC path to ground.

t_rise.description: Rise time of the driver output N1.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the PMOS pull-up current and the parasitic capacitance at node N1.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for the DAC current cell, measuring DC power, small-signal AC gain and bandwidth, and large-signal transient switching characteristics at 200 MHz.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for DAC Cell
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u

XM1 GND LABEL_NET_0 N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 GND N7 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 GND N2 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 GND LABEL_NET_2 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 GND N6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N7 N7 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N3 LABEL_NET_3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N0 LABEL_NET_4 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 GND N1 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N4 GND N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N5 GND N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N6 LABEL_NET_6 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 0.6
VLABEL_NET_4 LABEL_NET_4 0 1.0
VLABEL_NET_6 LABEL_NET_6 0 1.0

* Inputs: DC 0.9V for AC analysis, 200MHz Pulse for Transient
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 PULSE(0 1.8 0 100p 100p 2.4n 5n)
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 DC 0.9 AC -1 PULSE(1.8 0 0 100p 100p 2.4n 5n)

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1Meg 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(N1)
  meas ac max_gain max gain_db
  meas ac unity_gain_freq when gain_db=0 fall=1

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 10p 15n
  meas tran v_max_n1 max v(N1)
  meas tran v_min_n1 min v(N1)
  meas tran t_rise_n1 trig v(N1) val=0.5 rise=1 targ v(N1) val=1.0 rise=1
  meas tran t_fall_n1 trig v(N1) val=1.0 fall=1 targ v(N1) val=0.5 fall=1
  
  let vdiff = v(N1) - v(N2)
  meas tran v_cross find v(N1) when vdiff=0 cross=1
.endc
.end
